notes: WArmy 0.4.33 — zero-burden preset expansion: four new original presets (all self-drawn/procedural, CC0-equivalent, no third-party licenses): 2D 雪团 (snowball) and 墨鲤 (ink koi) as finished SVG art, 3D 紫鸮 (purple owl) and 赤狐 (red fox) as procedural-skeleton color/proportion variants with real preview art. Built-in presets now 2D×8 / 3D×5; the first-run default stays the list-head logo (new presets appended after it). Verified on real Electron: each new 2D preset renders byte-identical to its art via the finished-SVG passthrough, each new 3D preset builds a live WebGL procedural skeleton (no GLTF), and switching back releases the 3D canvas (probe 8/8). The mimic interaction source-regression gate was aligned to the current R228 right-click/hold/stroke semantics and re-admitted to the full suite (38/0). Full-feature acceptance with per-round varying test data passed three consecutive clean rounds (92 gates + unit invariants per round). Carries all R232/R233 features and security hardening unchanged.
